negative_reviews.author: Tracey Smith
negative_reviews.text: Came here with my son. Ordered goyoza,  ramen chicken/noodle dish and green dragon roll. I asked for a coconut mango matcha latte but was told they didnt have any, dispite flyers on every table advertising it. I then asked for a lychee juice (something I have everytime I visit your aberdeen store), server didn't know and would have to check. My sons ramen came and it was missing the pork and I never got a drink to have with my food, not by choice. When we asked for containers to take the food home they didn't bring enough and we had to ask for one more for my sons ramen. We didnt get a bag, we were not offered so as we were carrying out 4 containers of food someone not in uniform asked us if we would like a bag. If this had been my first experience in a maki and ramen I would not hurry back. But within the last 7 days I have been to your aberdeen store, here everything is exceptional especially the staff and service. I have also visited your Leith store, which was good. We were told the visit today was below par because the staff were new!

negative_reviews.text: Great venue, friendly staff, unfortunately tasteless watery Ramen which Lacked any flavour.

issues: A one to two star review was received about sour Char Siu; the batch had been served without prior testing and the product has now been replaced by the supplier.
The site is short of a kitchen porter on weekdays and has been authorised to add three and a half kitchen porter hours per day, Monday to Sunday.
Temporary cover has been arranged from 24/09/2026, with one team member from Edinburgh supporting for three days followed by Newcastle and Aberdeen cover for the sushi section.
Ordering has been under close oversight for the last two weeks, with orders that look excessive queried or cancelled directly.
Stock issues remain ongoing and out of stock items on the bar are a significant problem, with little room for margin in the budget.
A manager is leaving, so the rota balance needs watching and a further supervisor or an internal promotion may be required.
Some low star ratings were attributed to staff training gaps and extra training is being given.
The app is running smoothly with freshers vouchers registering, and a further influx is expected as freshers continues.
Hires have been completed and onboarding is in progress on the talent funnel.
Hygiene checks, the waste log, sickness and lateness records and the budget and Kobas rotas were all complete for the week.
